typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		WeekEnding as string,
		Entity as string,
		TraceGroup as string,
		Product_Volume as string,
		Product_Volume_Late as string,
		Amber_Threshold as string,
		Red_Threshold as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> TraceKRIMetric	source(output(
		weekEnding as string,
		entity as string,
		traceGroup as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
TraceKRIMetric derive(TraceGroup_Drv = 'TRACE_' + TraceGroup) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of TraceGroup_Drv} = TraceGroup_Drv) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(TraceKRIMetric@Entity == LookupLKPTABLE@entity && TraceKRIMetric@WeekEnding == LookupLKPTABLE@weekEnding && TraceKRIMetric@TraceGroup == LookupLKPTABLE@traceGroup,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		redThreshold as double,
		traceGroup as string,
		productVolumeLate as integer,
		weekEnding as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		productVolume as integer,
		entity as string,
		amberThreshold as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		redThreshold = Red_Threshold,
		traceGroup = {Copy of TraceGroup_Drv},
		productVolumeLate = Product_Volume_Late,
		weekEnding = WeekEnding,
		productVolume = Product_Volume,
		entity = Entity,
		amberThreshold = Amber_Threshold),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
